description:
## Goal

Make native compilation incremental below the root: publish one immutable native-body product per exact semantic codegen identity, compile only new or changed bodies, and relink only affected membership/symbol/relocation readers.

## Authorities

Use fz-tfn.44 stable backend references, fz-kdt.48 denotational types, fz-kdt.200 final activation identity, and fz-tfn.40 content/provenance separation. ProductMemo owns retained native bodies, compiled generations and link products. No root-relative dense id, rendered type, raw interner order or second backend cache is identity.

One return-payload position has one exact analyzed type/demand. Delivered results use the actual call-result position; tail results use the enclosing return. Callable arity comes from typed semantic callable identity. If the interpreter fallback deriving arity from pruned layouts is unreachable, delete it; otherwise consume the same identity. Never reconstruct omitted layouts.

## Required deletion

Delete the post-lowering whole-root sibling-graph dedup/index/compare/remap pass from fz-kdt.163 after transferring its positive and negative equivalence laws. Delete whole-program body walks, unconditional backend recreation, duplicated return-payload type/demand branches, layout-derived arity authority, obsolete counters and transition fixtures.

## TDD and acceptance

Same root twice and an unrelated edit perform zero native-body lowering, codegen and relink. A reached leaf edit compiles only the exact body and required link dependents. Preserve callable construction, captures, direct targets, ABI/layout, effects, externs, symbols, debug/provenance behavior, runtime output and canonical artifacts. Deterministic body/product generations and compile counts are authoritative.

This ticket absorbs fz-tfn.42 and fz-tfn.43.
title: Reuse native code generation by changed function generation
